jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
Position Snapshot

Location: Petaling Jaya, Selangor, MY
Company: Nestlé Products Sdn Bhd
Business Unit: Nestlé Professional
Position: Brand Manager
Category: Dairy & Confectionery
Full-time
Bachelor’s Degree
2–3 years of Brand Management experience

Position Summary

Joining Nestlé means joining the world's largest Food and Beverage Company. At our core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

As a Brand Manager , you will be responsible for the Dairy & Confectionery category , building strong brands, understanding consumers deeply and driving sustainable business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and execute brand strategies, innovation plans and engaging consumer experiences.

A Day in the Life of Brand Manager

Consumer & Brand Understanding

-
Develop and update the consumer portrait and consumer engagement funnel for your brand.

-
Translate consumer and shopper insights into relevant brand strategies and initiatives.

-
Activate the Brand Essence and ensure consistent brand building across key touchpoints.

-
Monitor brand performance and identify opportunities to drive market share and business growth.

Product, Innovation & Renovation

-
Manage the 60/40+ agenda, packaging, NHW and other product experience initiatives for your brand.

-
Contribute to the innovation and renovation pipeline, ensuring launches are relevant to consumer needs.

-
Work with cross-functional teams to deliver innovation projects on time and in line with business objectives.

Shopper & Commercial Strategy

-
Understand the in-store environment and contribute to category strategy.

-
Provide recommendations on pricing and promotional strategies.

-
Propose relevant SKUs and channel strategies based on shopper and customer needs.

-
Support the development of initiatives that strengthen the brand across key channels and customers.

Brand Planning & Execution

-
Contribute to the development and execution of the brand and Integrated Commercial Planning (ICP) plan.

-
Track brand performance, investment and key business KPIs.

-
Manage brand investments including PFME and TTS to ensure effective use of resources.

-
Work closely with Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Consumer Insights, Digital and other stakeholders to deliver plans effectively.

Communication & Consumer Engagement

-
Contribute to the development of OBIs, Big Ideas and consumer engagement strategies.

-
Partner with communication agencies to develop engaging brand experiences.

-
Ensure brand communication is consistent with the brand strategy and Nestlé's commitment to being a trusted Nutrition, Health and Wellness leader.

-
Communicate and collaborate effectively with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders across relevant business functions.

What Will Make You Successful

-
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a relevant field. An MBA would be an added advantage.

-
2–3 years of experience in Brand Management , ideally within FMCG.

-
Strong proficiency in Mandarin is mandatory , as the role requires regular communication and collaboration with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.

-
Proficiency in Cantonese and Bahasa Malaysia would be an added advantage.

-
Experience working in cross-functional teams.

-
Strong understanding of consumers, shoppers and the commercial environment.

-
Good analytical and project management skills, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.

-
Strong brand management, consumer marketing and innovation capabilities.

-
Able to work effectively under pressure , manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight timelines.

-
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

-
Proactive, results-oriented and able to take initiative.

-
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and managing multiple priorities.

Position Snapshot

Location: Malaysia

Full-time

Position Summary

Joining CPW means joining one of the world's leading breakfast cereal businesses, a strategic partnership between Nestlé and General Mills. We are passionate about creating brands that consumers love while driving sustainable growth across our markets.

We are looking for a Head of Marketing, CPW Southeast Asia Cluster to lead demand creation, brand performance, and marketing excellence across Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia. This role will translate global brand and portfolio strategies into cluster growth plans, ensuring consistent execution, strong commercial impact, and a unified marketing approach across markets.

In addition, you will lead the brand strategy, communications, innovation, and renovation agenda for KOKO KRUNCH® and MILO® Cereals across the Southeast Asia Cluster and other markets where the brands are present.

Lead Cluster Marketing Strategy & Planning

- Translate global brand strategies and innovation platforms into cluster-specific growth plans.

- Build and execute the annual cluster marketing plan aligned with business priorities and investment choices.

- Identify high-potential markets, occasions, and consumer segments to unlock growth opportunities.

- Drive brand performance, market share growth, and business results across the cluster.

Drive Media, Activation & Agency Excellence

- Develop and oversee the cluster media strategy to maximize reach, effectiveness, and ROI.

- Lead integrated marketing campaigns and activation excellence across markets.

- Manage agency partnerships to deliver high-quality and consistent execution.

- Establish robust performance measurement frameworks and marketing dashboards.

Lead Insights & Performance Management

- Consolidate consumer, shopper, and competitive insights to inform business decisions.

- Partner with global teams by sharing market insights that shape future brand strategy and innovation.

- Analyze business performance and optimize media, pricing, promotion, and portfolio strategies.

Strengthen Commercial Partnerships

- Act as the key marketing partner to Cluster Sales and Customer Development teams.

- Align demand generation initiatives with channel and customer priorities.

- Support the development of compelling customer sell-in stories and activation plans.

Lead & Develop the Marketing Team

- Coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing multi-market marketing team.

- Foster collaboration, capability building, and best-practice sharing across markets.

- Create an environment that encourages innovation, agility, and continuous improvement.

Lead KOKO KRUNCH & MILO Cereals Brand Strategy

- Oversee the regional brand agenda for KOKO KRUNCH and MILO Cereals.

- Develop brand strategies, communications, and innovation & renovation pipelines.

- Drive long-term brand growth and business performance across Southeast Asia and beyond.

What Will Make You Successful

- Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related discipline.

- 10+ years of progressive FMCG marketing experience, including regional leadership exposure.

- Proven track record of translating global brand strategies into market growth plans.

- Strong experience in integrated marketing, media planning, activation, innovation, and agency management.

jobs.title: Vet Field Sales Manager
jobs.description:
At Purina, it's no secret that pets are our passion. Our vision is to be the world’s most trusted company in enriching the lives of pets and the people who love them.

We’re dedicated to improving the health and lifestyle of cats and dogs through quality nutrition and care. Put simply, we believe a healthy pet makes for a happier home and our commitment to dogs, cats and their owners has made us a world leader in pet care.

The bonds we have with our pets nourish their lives as well as ours – we truly believe Pets and People are better together.

THE OPPORTUNITIY

Lead a national team. Shape execution in-store. Influence the future of some of Australia's most loved pet care brands.

As  Vet Field Sales Manager , you'll be at the heart of our sales success, leading a national team to execute winning retail strategies, strengthen customer relationships, and accelerate growth.  This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially savvy and people-focused leader to make a significant impact at both a strategic and operational level.

A DAY IN THE LIFE OF…

Reporting to the National Field Sales Manager, you'll lead and inspire a national team of Vet Territory Managers, creating the conditions for success through coaching, capability building, and a relentless focus on execution excellence.

- Lead, coach and develop a high-performing field sales team, building capability and driving a culture of ownership and accountability.

- Shape and execute Vet field sales strategies that grow market share, strengthen brand visibility, and elevate customer engagement.

- Partner closely with Marketing, Category and Commercial teams to bring business priorities to life in-store.

- Develop and deliver annual field plans aligned to business objectives and customer strategies.

- Lead execution across key customers including Vet Clinics and Pet Specialty, ensuring strong commercial outcomes and flawless implementation.

- Use performance insights and market intelligence to identify opportunities, solve challenges, and drive continuous improvement.

- Build trusted relationships with customers and stakeholders, influencing outcomes and delivering sustainable growth.

- Maintain a strong presence in the field through regular customer and team visits across metropolitan and regional Nationally.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL

You're a proven sales leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and knows how to translate strategy into action.

You’ll bring:

- Ideally Degree qualified in Veterinary Science, Animal Science, Nutrition or a related field.

- Proven senior sales, field leadership or account management experience within the vet channel, animal health, pet health, pharmaceutical or premium FMCG environment.

- Strong understanding of veterinary clinic operations, customer dynamics, wholesalers, corporate clinic groups and buying groups.

- Ability to turn shopper, clinic, category and customer insights into growth opportunities across recommendation, education, ranging and sales uptake.

- Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop high-performing field teams with strong technical confidence, commercial capability and execution discipline.

- Strong commercial acumen, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience managing investment to deliver profitable growth.

- Ability to balance strategy with hands-on field execution, supported by strong Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Power BI capability.

- Ability and willingness to travel regularly across states, including regional and overnight travel.

- A genuine passion for pets and Purina’s purpose of creating richer lives for pets and the people who love them.

Full Australian working rights and applicants may be required to undergo pre-employment checks, including but not limited to health checks, prior to appointment to this role.

BENEFITS

You will have the chance to work with an outstanding and highly engaged team, build and grow your career with an inclusive, global FMCG leader.

- Competitive salary + attractive bonus program

- Up to 5 ‘KitKat Days’ each year to rest, recharge and support your wellbeing

- Personalised development and varied career opportunities within a global FMCG leader

- Wellbeing perks including free flu vaccinations, discounted private health insurance, and discounted gym memberships

- Access to Purchased Leave, Volunteering Leave, Sports Leave and Emergency Services Leave

- Up to 18 weeks Paid Parental Leave

- Discounts on Nestlé products and offers from our retail and service partners

- Novated leasing options

- Salary sacrifice to superannuation

Our Story

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering an inclusive, diverse, and collaborative environment, embracing innovation, and empowering people and teams to win.

We aim to hire respectful, curious, value driven and inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.

Be a force for good.

For more information, please visit our website  Nestlé Australia Home | Nestlé Australia (nestle.com.au)

We want to make finding your dream job possible. If you require additional support with your application, please contact us at  careers@au.nestle.com

Apply today!

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Category Management Specialist - Packaging (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

Position Summary:

Lead the procurement strategy for key packaging categories supporting Nestlé Health Science U.S., managing a portfolio of approximately $50M to $70M in spend. In this highly visible role, you will develop and execute category strategies, negotiate supplier agreements, and build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and suppliers to drive cost savings, innovation, quality, service, and supply continuity.

The ideal candidate brings deep packaging expertise within the food, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, personal care, or chemical industries, along with strong sourcing, supplier management, and contract negotiation experience.

Location Preference:

- This role is primarily remote; however, candidates located on Tri-State area (New York, New Jersey & Conneticut) are strongly preferred to support in-person trainings, meetings, and other business needs.

- This role will report to Holistic Health

Key Responsibilities:

- Develops and implements long term Category Strategies and yearly sourcing plan for Procurement of several categories of spend for Nestle Health Science US (10-15%)

- Develop and manage continuous improvement pipeline to deliver significant year-over-year productivity. Ensure saving tracking in partnership with Finance. (5-10%)

- Executes market research in various areas, resulting in robust Category Strategies.  Keeps abreast of market conditions and maintains an agile mindset to flex resources and external capacity as needed to meet changing business needs. (10-15%)

- Ensures optimize sourcing, supplier selection, pricing, contracting and commercialization while meeting quality and service level requirements for their spend area.  This results in ensuring negotiation and implementation of supplier agreements to deliver the greatest overall value. Monitors supplier performance on an ongoing basis and develop improvement plans as required. (10-15%)

- Ensure proactive risk management strategy as well as partnering with supply planning team to ensure timely problem solving of supply issues. (5-10%)

- Liaises with various commercial teams to ensure two-way dialogue and understanding of business/brand needs as well as industry trends and opportunities in their area of expertise. (5%-10%)

- Supports new products, new technology or new initiative launches as applicable. Leverage supplier partner in securing differenced ingredients and technology. (5%-10%)

- Support various transformation projects (such as Network optimization, complexity reduction) on as needed basis (5%)

- Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of Procurement data in ERP.  (5%)

- Manage monthly price forecast review process. (5%)

Experience & Education Requirements:

-
Bachelor's degree preferred in Business, Engineering, Food Science, or a related field. Relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

- 5+ years of knowledge of packaging categories including corrugate, folding cartons, labels, flexible packaging, rigid containers, closures, and related materials preferred

- Strong experience in packaging materials procurement, preferably within food, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, consumer goods, or related manufacturing industries.

- Broad background in Procurement supporting manufacturing/ commercial/ corporate functions in various operating models.

- Has the ability to work and communicate effectively at all levels and functions of the organization.

- Multiple years of increasing responsibility, experience in both procurement and the subject matter area are preferred.

SKILLS:

-
Highly self-motivated with the ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and establish effective processes and procedures.

-
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive resolution of complex business challenges.

-
Strong knowledge of strategic sourcing, category management, and supplier relationship management.

-
Excellent project management and organizational skills.

-
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including data analysis and process improvement.

-
Customer-focused mindset with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.

-
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

-
Experience with Oracle ERP systems preferred.

-
Supply chain experience, including planning and logistics, preferred.

-
Ability to effectively partner with technical stakeholders and understand technical requirements.

-
Demonstrated success working in a global, matrixed organization.

-
Experience drafting, negotiating, and managing supplier contracts.

-
Foundational financial acumen, including P&L analysis, budgeting, and cash flow management.

#LI-KO1

The approximate pay range for this position is $85,000.00 to $95,000.00. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location.

The Human Resources Manager serves as a strategic HR partner to assigned corporate functions, translating business priorities and enterprise people strategy into talent, organizational, and employee experience solutions. The role anticipates workforce needs, strengthens leadership and talent pipelines, enables transformation, and builds an engaged, future-ready workforce.

Using workforce insights, business acumen, and HR expertise, role identifies people and organizational opportunities, develops recommendations, and influences decisions. · Translate enterprise HR strategies, standards, and tools into practical solutions for assigned client groups.

· Partner with HR Centers of Competence to deliver coordinated, scalable solutions with clear ownership, decision-making, and accountability, avoiding unnecessary duplication or customization.

· Demonstrated ownership of a people strategy or plan for an assigned function, division, or client group.

· Experience leading talent, succession, performance, and workforce planning processes with clear follow-through and outcomes.

· Experience coaching leaders through complex performance, talent, employee relations, or organizational decisions.

· Experience leading organization design, restructuring, integration, or significant change initiatives.

· Ability to use workforce and employee insights and cross-functional partnerships to diagnose issues, influence decisions, implement integrated solutions, and track outcomes.

· Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, HR policies, employee relations practices, and investigation principles.

jobs.description:
Total Rewards Market Partnership Expert

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced Total Rewards professional to join our Regional Rewards Centre of Competence as a GPPT and Market Partnership Expert.

In this specialist role, you will provide strategic guidance and functional expertise across multiple markets, supporting the effective delivery of Total Rewards programmes, policies and processes. You will act as a trusted partner to market Total Rewards teams and senior stakeholders, providing advice on compensation strategy, annual reward processes, market benchmarking, job evaluation, pay structures and rewards governance.

The role offers an opportunity to shape Total Rewards practices across markets, lead key regional initiatives and build the capabilities of local Rewards teams.

Responsibilities

· Provide strategic input and consultation to market Total Rewards teams in the design and implementation of local Total Rewards strategies, aligned with global and regional guidance and market priorities.

· Act as the primary Total Rewards point of contact for assigned markets, businesses, joint ventures, zones and categories.

· Partner with market Rewards teams to plan and execute annual compensation processes, including salary review budgeting, salary review execution, short-term bonuses, long-term incentives, job sizing, gender equal pay, living wage analysis and salary surveys.

· Support and lead Market Compensation Committees, ensuring that key reward decisions are reviewed and approved at the appropriate market, zone or corporate level.

· Analyse external compensation data, market trends and salary survey results to provide reliable insights and recommendations to business and HR stakeholders.

· Develop and review pay structures in partnership with local Rewards teams and conduct market pricing exercises for critical, new or high-demand roles.

· Conduct job analysis and job evaluation activities, ensuring that positions are accurately understood, appropriately graded and managed in line with relevant governance requirements.

· Promote the simplification and standardisation of position evaluation processes across markets while maintaining high levels of data quality.

· Lead or coordinate regional and global Total Rewards projects, ensuring effective market coverage and delivery within agreed timelines.

· Support the transition of selected Rewards activities to shared service teams, ensuring a seamless process and positive employee experience throughout the transition and hypercare period.

· Ensure compliance with compensation policies and governance requirements, including appropriate documentation and approval of key reward decisions.

· Develop and deliver Total Rewards training programmes for HR and Rewards communities.

· Coach and mentor Total Rewards colleagues, particularly new team members, and contribute to capability-building initiatives across the function.

What Will Make You Successful

· A university degree or an equivalent qualification.

· At least five years of Human Resources experience gained within a large organisation with progressive people practices and/or an HR consulting environment.

· Strong experience in compensation, rewards, employee cost management or workforce budgeting.

· Practical knowledge of job analysis and job evaluation methodologies, such as IPE or an equivalent methodology.

· Experience in external market benchmarking, compensation analysis, market pricing and salary structure design.

· Strong understanding of annual compensation processes, including salary reviews, incentive programmes and long-term incentive arrangements.

· Experience in developing and using HR metrics, KPIs and data-driven insights.

· Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyse complex datasets and translate findings into practical compensation recommendations.

· Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.

· The ability to influence without formal authority and build credible professional relationships across functions and geographies.

· Strong project-management, organisational and time-management capabilities.

· The ability to work effectively under pressure and manage demanding deadlines.

· A collaborative mindset and the ability to contribute effectively within multifunctional and international teams.

Additional Experience That Would Be an Advantage

· Experience working in the FMCG sector.

· Experience using SAP HR or similar HR systems.

· Knowledge of local employment law and labour regulations.

· A professional qualification in remuneration or compensation methodologies.

· Experience with compensation benchmarking tools and salary survey platforms, including Mercer tools or equivalent solutions.

· Exposure to international transfer management, including mobility packages, relocation, taxation and immigration considerations.

Key Stakeholders

You will collaborate with market and regional Total Rewards teams, HR leaders, Finance, IT, corporate Rewards teams, shared service organisations and other internal stakeholders. You will also engage with salary survey providers, HR consultancies, compensation forums and external professional networks.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to apply your Total Rewards expertise in a highly collaborative and international environment. You will influence compensation strategy across multiple markets, contribute to regional and global Rewards initiatives, and help strengthen the capabilities of Total Rewards teams across the organisation.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Total Rewards professional with strong analytical capabilities, business acumen and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, we would welcome your application.

Position Summary

As the Manager, Brand Marketing Combined Consumer & Product Experience (CX/PX), you will lead the comprehensive brand experience across communications, product, and commercial touchpoints. This role architects how the brand is experienced through both first and second moments of truth by integrating consumer experience, product experience, innovation, launches, packaging, claims, media, digital, and commercial activation.  This role owns the coordination, execution, and delivery of key initiatives that bring the brand strategy to life and create meaningful consumer communications and experiences across the funnel.

Key Responsibilities

Consumer , Category, & Customer (3C) Understanding

- Lead the translation of consumer, category, customer, and competitive insights into integrated brand and product strategies that inform innovation, communications, activation, and portfolio priorities.

- Synthesize consumer learning, business performance, and marketplace data into actionable recommendations that shape brand-building decisions and strengthen consumer engagement across touchpoints.

- Guide cross-functional teams in applying insights to develop integrated strategies across innovation, product experience, communications, media, and commercial activation.

- Leverage performance data, consumer learning, and marketplace signals to identify optimization opportunities and improve brand experiences, communications effectiveness, and business outcomes.

Innovation & Renovation

- Lead integrated brand, product, and innovation deliverables aligned to approved strategy, ensuring consistency across communications, product experience, and consumer touchpoints.

- Own the development and rollout of brand fundamentals, innovation initiatives, communications plans, and commercialization strategies that strengthen brand equity and consumer engagement.

- Lead new item launch plans across product, communications, and commercial channels, coordinating cross-functional inputs and deliverables to ensure launch readiness and seamless activation.

- Own execution timelines, key milestones, and deployment of launch content, activation materials, and sell-in tools throughout the I2L lifecycle.

- Ensure execution reflects approved brand positioning, product claims, messaging, and consumer experience while delivering assets and initiatives that bring the brand strategy to life in market.

- Partner across cross-functional teams to translate strategy into execution, driving excellence across innovation, launch, and activation initiatives from concept through commercialization.

Communications & Unrivaled Superiority for Product & Packaging

- Lead end-to-end product and communications initiatives across renovation, superiority, packaging, claims, and consumer-facing content, ensuring delivery against approved brand strategy and product agenda priorities.

- Own alignment between product truth and communication delivery by ensuring claims, messaging, packaging, and consumer experiences are accurate, compliant, and consistent across touchpoints.

- Lead coordination with Regulatory, R&D, Supply Chain, CD, and agency partners to execute packaging updates, product initiatives, and consumer-facing communications.

- Lead team in day-to-day management of asset development and deployment, ensuring all materials meet compliance, quality, and brand standards.

- Lead execution of cross-functional product agenda initiatives, coordinating inputs, timelines, and deliverables to drive seamless implementation across product and communications workstreams.

Unbeatable Value, Unmissable Visibility

- Lead the execution of commercial plans aligned to brand strategy, ensuring pricing, promotion, portfolio, and shopper marketing priorities are effectively translated into market activation.

- Own cross-functional coordination of inputs across CD, Finance, SRM, and Shopper Marketing teams to deliver integrated commercial and retail execution.

- Monitor shopper marketing, digital shelf, and eCommerce deliverables, including PDPs, content, assets, and consumer-facing materials that strengthen brand visibility, maintain brand consistency, and engagement.

- Ensure digital shelf excellence through timely updates, content deployment, and ongoing management of product information and brand assets across channels.

- Identify opportunities to enhance unmissable visibility, drive shopper conversion, and improve the consumer experience across physical and digital marketplaces.

Business Management

- Lead monthly business reviews (MBP/MBR) for marketing, enterprise forecasting, and annual planning processes by ensuring innovation inputs, new item performance updates, and recommendations that inform business decisions.

- Champion annual planning, budgeting, and cross-functional business management activities.

- Monitor performance metrics, deliverables, timelines, and key business initiatives across consumer and product workstreams.

- Ensure cross-functional inputs to ensure alignment and execution against brand priorities.

- Monitor executional performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Talent Management

- Champion the Nestlé Ways of Winning by setting clear expectations, role modeling desired behaviors, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture that enables teams to thrive and deliver business results.

- Lead by example to motivate and inspire team to exceed performance targets

- Actively communicate expectations and provide regular feedback against those expectations through a robust performance management process, working with each team member to evaluate performance, provide feedback and training.

- Work with direct reports to build appropriate development plans and coach team to ensure that the training activities achieve mutual, agreed upon objectives.

- Participate in talent recruitment and selection to staff the organizations with the best people for current jobs, as well as future leadership, promoting workforce diversity

- Fostering the sharing of best practices.

Qualifications/Certifications

- Typically has a University Degree (BA/BS) in Marketing or related business field; or equivalent experience

- MBA preferred.

- In-depth knowledge of brand building management principles and practices.

- Strong negotiation, agency management, and relationship-building skills.

- Strong research and strategic analysis skills.

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and manage agency partners.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to translate ambiguity into clear recommendations and action plans.

- Excellent communication (both verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.

- Strong financial acumen and the understanding of calculating risk/return on business decisions.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, lead projects independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Applications.

Critical Experiences

- At least 5 years of work experience in brand or product management, marketing, or a related field

- Proven track record leading brand strategy, innovation, communications, product experience, or commercial activation initiatives that deliver business results.

- Demonstrated ability and initiative to drive cross-functional teams to deliver on collective brand goals.

- Experience leveraging data, research and trends to generate insights to understand consumer behavior (IRI or Nielsen knowledge strongly recommended).

- Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to develop creative/non-traditional solutions for challenging, undefined problems.

- Experience managing launches, packaging/claims workstreams, agency deliverables, and integrated activation plans across consumer and commercial touchpoints.

Position Snapshot:

Title: Out of Home (OOH) Sales Director

Business area: Waters & Premium Beverages Canada

Location: North York, ON (Hybrid)

Position Summary

This new role supports our Waters & Premium Beverages business and is dedicated to the Out of Home (OOH) channel, focusing on achieving sales and profit objectives by retaining and growing current customers while acquiring new ones. The position emphasizes leveraging strategic relationships to drive growth in key chains and distributor partners, with responsibilities including leading, managing, and training the OOH team to achieve Nestlé Waters sales and distribution goals. Success in this role is achieved through strong entrepreneurship and change management as we create a dedicated team to serve the channel, collaboration with internal departments and the development of relationships with key stakeholders and sales personnel.

A day in the life of an OOS Sales Director

- Lead the Nestle Waters OOH Sales team, including National accounts, Distributor Management and Field Sales (broker) areas.  Drive OOH sales strategy for our Premium International brands Maison Perrier, San Pellegrino and Acqua Panna, lead account acquisition across our portfolio of waters and beverages, ensure premium execution and drive aggressive channel growth.

- Lead a team of Key/Account Managers across QSR, FSR, FSM, Office Coffee & GPO channels and collaborate with cross-functional team members to accomplish desired business results for identified categories or Accounts within the National Account team.  Lead the development of Customer/ Category plans (JBPs). Manage product listings, programming, transitions, and discontinuations with distributor merchandising and sales teams, while leading negotiation strategies for key regional and national accounts

- Work hand in hand with the broker to lead image account acquisition (restaurants, hotels, bars) and sales development. Define goals and ensure necessary investment is available.

- Lead and manage team to Identify, monitor and address specific issues to achieve NWPB's goals for sales, profitability, share, distribution such as Gap closing initiatives

- Lead the management and negotiation strategy of all National and regional accounts, distributor relationships and street customer sales across the country. Suggests and delivers yearly new account acquisition targets, ensuring focus on both our core (waters) and on growth pools (innovative beverages)

- Develop collaborative relationships with key customer levels and other external contacts

- Co-ordinate and review the distributor strategy on a yearly basis to ensure the right coverage and generating demand are in place to win in the channel. Ensure good alignment of strategies with retail sales team, especially for customers at the border between both channels

- Minimum 10 years in commercial operations in OOH, with at least 8 years in sales and over this period has successfully delivered on KPIs, especially top and bottom line business results

- Understands all sales functions

- Builder and entrepreneurial mindset with a bias to finding solutions in an agile and fast paced environment, with a strong ability to not only follow but lead change

- Has consistently demonstrated success in a number of challenging and diverse sales roles

- Successful track record of developing people

- Ability to think strategically and work collaboratively

- Proven experience with premium brands ideally in beverages category (alcoholic or non alcoholic)

- In-depth knowledge of channel pillars (QSR, Restaurants, Bars, Lodging, Chain Establishments, RTM) and their operational impact on business performance

- Experience working with MS Office: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

- Effective communication, negotiation, and leadership skills for presenting analytics to stakeholders

- Ability to build relationships with influential customers and teams across multiple channels

- Financial acumen and understanding of customer contributions and margin calculations

- Proven ability to manage multiple tasks with excellent time and project management skills

- Comprehensive total rewards benefits package including Health and Dental benefits that start on day one of employment

- Company matched pension plan

- Four weeks of Vacation and five personal days (Personal Paid Holidays)

- Flexible and hybrid work arrangements

- Excellent training and development programs as well as opportunities to grow within the company

- Access to Educational Assistance & Tuition Reimbursement

Driven by innovation, quality, and a passion for great coffee, Nespresso Professional has ambitious plans to grow its presence across the Out-Of-Home (OOH) sector across the UK & I sector. To support this mission, we’re looking for a resilient and motivated new team member to join our B2B HORECA team to really elevate our new business strategy.

We are the Nestlé Nespresso SA Company and are proud to be one of the fastest growing operating units of Nestlé. Our passionate, entrepreneurial-minded team has transformed Nespresso into one of the world’s most trusted brands. We guarantee quality by taking a careful, thoughtful, and sustainable approach to how we produce and market our premium coffee capsules and machines.

We take pride in championing inclusion and diversity. We proudly signed the Business in the Community Race at Work Charter, are committed to Disability Confidence, and have been recognised as a Times Top 50 Employer for gender equality for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are a headline partner of Diversity and Inclusion in grocery.

Your impact
In this role, you’ll work cross functionally to drive new business sales growth and enhance the visibility of the Nespresso Professional brand within the OOH channel.

Some key responsibilities include:

•    Tenacious Acquisition: Pursue and secure new HORECA and hospitality clients within targeted groups, driving our growth strategy forward.
•    Maximise Brand Visibility: Ensure our brand shines brightly in the HORECA channel through strategic customer acquisition, impactful contracts, and optimal machine placements.
•    Cultivate Relationships: Forge and nurture strong relationships with both new and existing customers to cross sell, upsell and boost overall sales and loyalty.
•    Build Your Pipeline: Actively create a robust pipeline of sales opportunities through cold calling, networking, emails, events, and industry-specific fairs.

Your ingredients for success
To thrive in this role, you’ll bring previous B2B customer-facing experience and have a strong understanding of how to build relationships and influence stakeholders. This opportunity is ideal for someone with a genuine entrepreneurial nature and someone who approaches challenges with a can-do attitude, never backing down from a goal.

Other key attributes will include:

•    Have a deep understanding of the out of home market, specifically the leisure and hospitality landscape.
•    Bring previous experience from a results-oriented environment where hitting targets is second nature.
•    Showcase extensive skills in new business development, with a proven track record of success.
•    Develop and maintain strong business partnerships that foster growth and collaboration within a new and existing account base.
•    Demonstrate a steadfast dedication to customer support and satisfaction through exceptional account management.
•    A full driving licence is required for this role.
•    Thrive in an autonomous environment, taking initiative to drive your success.
•    Possess strong consultative and solution-selling skills to meet customer needs effectively.
•    Winning mentality

If you're ready to take the next step in your sales career and make a significant impact in the HORECA sector, we want to hear from you! Join us and be part of our winning team!

jobs.title: Procurement Manager - Warehousing
jobs.description:
Location: Panama City, Panama
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Starting Date: January 2027

Be a force for good and feel trusted to make decisions that matter.

As a Global Procurement Manager for Warehousing at Nestlé Global Procurement, you will be responsible for defining and implementing the category strategy for the 3PL Warehousing spend in scope by using strategic sourcing processes, tools and policies, as well as working closely with the Nestle Corporate & Zone Logistics functions to drive the implementation of the category strategy, support innovation and drive standardization processes.

We operate on a truly global scale, bringing together over 40 nationalities across three dynamic hubs in Switzerland, Panama, and Malaysia. This is your chance to drive innovation, sustainability, and impact at scale, ensuring value creation through responsibly sourced supply across diverse categories.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Procurement Manager - Warehousing

- Define and align with key stakeholders the global category strategy for the spend and drive the implementation process by working closely with the business and the local procurement organizations.

- Implement key Strategic Sourcing processes, tools and policies such as Request for Quotations (RFQ), supplier management, standardization, aggregation.

- Perform supplier market/category/supply risk analysis and develop Total Cost Ownership (TCO) models to identify improvement opportunities and implement them.

- Introduce / develop new suppliers in close cooperation with the Logistics standard owners.

- Negotiate supply contracts ensuring the most beneficial commercial agreements with suppliers in line with the category strategy and in collaboration with Nestrade Legal team.

- Manage and lead supplier relations with key strategic suppliers under the category’s scope.

- Ensure compliance with Nestlé's Corporate Business Principles, policies, and standards.

What will make you successful

- Degree in Procurement, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Economics, Finance, or Engineering.

- 10 years of experience in strategic sourcing, ideally with a regional or global scope, ideally gained in Procurement of Warehousing or Logistics or within Operations in a 3PL company.

- Proven track record in leading cross-functional projects, driving change, and demonstrating strong functional leadership.

- Solid experience in category sourcing, TCO modelling, risk management, and Supplier Relationship Management (incl. claims management).

- Strong interest in Automation, Robotics, and new technologies, with solid understanding and use of digital tools and AI.

- Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence internally and externally with global suppliers.

- Fluency in English is essential, Spanish is a big plus.

At Nestlé Global Procurement, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

- Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

Position summary

- Location: South Adelaide and Riverland, SA

The Opportunity

At Purina, it's no secret that pets are our passion. Our vision is to be the world’s most trusted company in enriching the lives of pets and the people who love them.

We’re dedicated to improving the health and lifestyle of cats and dogs through quality nutrition and care. Put simply, we believe a healthy pet makes for a happier home and our commitment to dogs, cats and their owners has made us a world leader in pet care.

The bonds we have with our pets nourish their lives as well as ours – we truly believe Pets and People are better together.

We are looking for a focused  Sales Professional  to take ownership of our territory covering  South Adelaide, Riverland and surrounding districts to drive sales, distribution and growth.

Our team of Territory Sales Managers enjoy a unique mix of customers including independent grocers, corporate & independent specialty retailers, as well as multi-site operators.

This mix provides you with the opportunity to incorporate all of your sales skills as you take on the role of category expert, influential negotiator, and customer business partner.

This role is perfect for an ambitious and well-presented individual with a passion for pets. Through your previous sales experience you will be able to demonstrate success working in cross-functional teams, guiding, and leading our customers to maximise sales results in your area.

Some of your responsibilities will include:

- Facilitating training sessions in-store with sales staff on Purina products and superior nutritional solutions

- Developing and maintaining strong relationships with external customers and key internal contacts

- Delivering customer sales through implementation and execution of Field Sales Cycle Plan

- Ensuring customer/shopper engagement through shelf and merchandising strategies

- Delivering to sales KPI’s

- Seeking out new business opportunities

- To succeed in this role, you will be an outgoing and commercially savvy person with a “can do” attitude who is ready to build an exciting career within a leading global FMCG.

- You will be passionate about our products, and you continually seek new opportunities.

- You will be joining a passionate team, you’ll enjoy a position that offers challenge, variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to build a solid foundation in commercial sales activities.

- You will have strong Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Power BI skills

- Ideally you will hold a completed degree (Commerce / Business / Marketing)

- You must have exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, as this is critical to building positive relationships with your customers.

- This role requires a valid, unrestricted Australian driver’s licence.

Full  Australian working rights  and applicants will be required to undergo pre-employment checks, including but not limited to health checks, prior to appointment to this role.

Benefits

You will have the chance to work with an outstanding and highly engaged team, build and grow your career with an inclusive, global FMCG leader.

In addition, we offer:

- Competitive salary + attractive bonus program

- Fully maintained company vehicle, plus a company phone and tablet

- Up to 5 ‘KitKat Days’ each year to rest, recharge and support your wellbeing

- Personalised development and varied career opportunities within a global FMCG leader

- Wellbeing perks including free flu vaccinations, discounted private health insurance, and discounted gym memberships including access to Fitness Passport

- Access to Purchased Leave, Volunteering Leave, Sports Leave and Emergency Services Leave

- Up to 18 weeks Paid Parental Leave

- Discounts on Nestlé products and offers from our retail and service partners

- Novated leasing options

- Salary sacrifice to superannuation

Our Story

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering an inclusive, diverse, and collaborative environment, embracing innovation, and empowering people and teams to win.

We aim to hire respectful, curious, value driven and inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.

Be a force for good.

jobs.title: Manager Marketing of Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Join Nestlé USA's Center for Demand Generation (CDG) as a Marketing Manager, Strategy & Operations . In this highly visible role, you will help shape and drive key enterprise marketing priorities, including marketing transformation, Trust & Transparency initiatives, and functional operations. Working across marketing, corporate affairs, and other cross-functional teams, you will translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, aligned execution, and scalable tools and processes that strengthen marketing effectiveness and help drive growth across Nestlé's Food & Beverage portfolio.

This role is ideal for a marketer, strategist, or business operations leader who enjoys driving organizational effectiveness, leading cross-functional initiatives, and translating complex business priorities into action across a large, matrixed organization.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic One Marketing and CDG Operations

- Lead core One Marketing and Center for Demand Generation routines, helping establish priorities, enable decision-making, and maintain the operating rhythm required to drive execution.

- Drive alignment on key initiatives by shaping agendas and content, engaging the right stakeholders, and ensuring decisions and actions move forward effectively.

- Continuously evolve team routines and engagement approaches based on business priorities, organizational learnings, and seasonal needs to improve effectiveness, focus, and collaboration.

- Support brand and business planning processes by translating strategic priorities into actionable plans, cross-functional alignment, and clear next steps.

Trust & Transparency

- Lead implementation of Nestlé USA's Trust & Transparency strategy by partnering with technical and content experts to shape priorities, tailor workstreams, and enable execution through playbooks, tools, and coaching.

- Serve as a strategic and operational partner across key forums, translating priorities into coordinated action across the broader Trust & Transparency organization.

- Amplify progress, milestones, and key advancements in ways that build understanding, credibility, and trust among internal and external stakeholders.

Marketing Transformation and Capability Development

- Help shape the future of the marketing function by identifying capability needs and partnering with Learning & Development to deliver tools, training, and enablement solutions that drive adoption at scale.

- Translate strategic priorities into practical tools, resources, and content that accelerate adoption, reinforce best practices, and strengthen marketing excellence across the organization.

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced business training preferred.

- 5+ years of experience in marketing, commercial strategy, business operations, management consulting, or related fields, with a demonstrated ability to translate strategic priorities into cross-functional plans and execution.

- Experience in CPG or other complex, matrixed organizations strongly preferred, particularly in roles requiring cross-functional influence, structured planning, and operational excellence.

EXPERIENCE / SKILLS

- Proven ability to influence across levels and functions, building alignment and momentum in complex, matrixed environments without direct authority.

- Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect business insights and organizational priorities to practical solutions.

- Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, adapt to change, and deliver results in fast-paced environments.

- High degree of ownership and self-direction, with the ability to operate independently and move work forward with sound judgment.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to tailor messages, facilitate alignment, and build credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

- Strong prioritization and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, bring structure to complex work, and consistently deliver high-quality outcomes.

jobs.description:
AT A GLANCE
Permanent contract – Full time – Senior leadership position
Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages
Based in Issy‑les‑Moulineaux, France
Global role with strong international exposure
10+ years’ experience in Data, Business Intelligence or Advanced Analytics
Fluent English, written, read and spoken

YOUR MISSION, SHOULD YOU ACCEPT IT:
As Global Data & Business Intelligence Lead, you play a key strategic role in accelerating data‑driven decision‑making across Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages. Your mission is contribute to design and deploy a smart, scalable Business Intelligence ecosystem, enabling advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and performance measurement across markets

Working closely with global and local teams, you act as a strategic partner to transform data into actionable insights and business impact. A critical pillar of your role is leading the end‑to‑end deployment of Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) across priority markets.

Your key responsibilities include:

Contribute to the deployment of a smart, scalable Business Intelligence solution that supports both global and local decision-making
Support the global BI vision and roadmap, aligned with business priorities and transformation objectives
Ensuring harmonization of KPIs, dashboards and reporting frameworks across countries
Translating advanced analytics into clear, actionable recommendations for business stakeholders

Leading cross‑country analytics and supporting markets in leveraging data for local decision‑making
Partnering with Marketing, Finance, Strategy and Sales teams to deliver insights driving business performance

Leading the deployment of a global Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) framework across priority markets
Ensuring methodological consistency and translating results into actionable business and media investment decisions

Driving predictive and prescriptive analytics using AI and machine learning
Ensuring data quality, governance and integration with the enterprise data ecosystem
Acting as a senior thought partner for global and market leadership teams
Building strong cross‑functional and international collaboration

ABOUT YOU:
University degree or equivalent, preferably in Data, Analytics, Engineering or a related field
10+ years of experience in Data, Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics or Performance Measurement

Proven experience within a leading data or measurement panel provider (e.g. Nielsen, Circana …), with strong exposure to retail data

Proven leadership experience in global, multi‑country environments, ideally within FMCG/CPG
Strong expertise in Marketing Mix Modeling and/or media effectiveness measurement
Hands‑on experience with predictive analytics, AI and machine learning
Strong experience in data transformation and scaling analytics capabilities

Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands‑on delivery mindset
Ability to bridge data science and business decision‑making
Strong stakeholder management skills at senior level
Leadership in matrix and multicultural environments
Fluent in English (French and Italian are a plus)

WHAT WE OFFER:
A competitive compensation package aligned with the seniority of the role
A highly visible and strategic position at the heart of business transformation
Strong exposure to senior leadership
An international and collaborative environment
The opportunity to shape the future of data, analytics and performance measurement at scale

WHO WE ARE:

Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages is a standalone, globally managed business within the Nestlé Group.

The company serves consumers in more than 100 markets with a portfolio of more than 35 brands, including S.Pellegrino, Perrier, Acqua Panna, Sanpellegrino Italian Sparkling Drinks, Maison Perrier, Buxton, Essentia, Levissima, La Vie  and Nestlé Pure Life .  Building on its heritage and expertise in waters, Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages is focused on growth in premium and better‑for‑you beverages, creating value for consumers, customers and stakeholders.

Water stewardship is central to the business. Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages is the only beverage company with all bottling sites certified to the Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard. Additionally, the company has implemented around 70 water regeneration projects globally, as part of its ambition to protect and restore more water than it uses, working with local stakeholders and experts to identify shared water challenges and support solutions that build resilience and benefit communities and nature.

An interview with a Recruiter
An interview with the Hiring Manager and/or HR
Additional interviews, assessments or case studies depending on the role

NWPB Data and Business Intelligence Lead

Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages
Poste basé à Issy‑les‑Moulineaux, France
Rôle global avec forte exposition internationale
10+ ans d’expérience en Data, Business Intelligence ou Advanced Analytics
Anglais courant à l’écrit et à l’oral

En tant que Global Data & Business Intelligence Lead, vous jouez un rôle stratégique clé dans l’accélération de la prise de décision data‑driven au sein de Nestlé Waters & Premium Beverages. Votre mission consiste à contribuer à la conception et au déploiement d’un écosystème de Business Intelligence intelligent et évolutif, permettant des analyses avancées, de la modélisation prédictive et la mesure de la performance sur l’ensemble des marchés.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes globales et locales, vous intervenez comme partenaire stratégique pour transformer la donnée en insights actionnables et en impact business. Un pilier clé du poste est le déploiement de bout en bout du Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) sur les marchés prioritaires.

Vos principales responsabilités incluent :

Contribuer au déploiement d’une solution de Business Intelligence intelligente et évolutive, qui soutient à la fois la prise de décision globale et locale.
Soutenir la vision et la feuille de route BI globales, alignées avec les priorités métiers et les objectifs de transformation.
Assurer l’harmonisation des KPI, dashboards et reportings à l’échelle internationale
Traduire les analyses avancées en recommandations business claires et actionnables

Développer des analyses transverses multi‑pays et accompagner les marchés dans leurs analyses locales
Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing, Finance, Stratégie et Sales pour soutenir la performance

Piloter le déploiement d’un framework global de Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
Garantir la robustesse méthodologique et la traduction des résultats en décisions d’investissement

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager - Contract Manufacturing | Operations Finance
jobs.description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Finance Manager is the financial leader of our Contract Manufacturing organization—a high-impact, dual-mandate role that combines strategic business partnering with ownership of financial delivery. You will serve as the Co-Pilot to the Vice President of Contract Manufacturing, helping shape strategy, frame the decisions that matter, and connect financial outcomes to operational and commercial levers across a complex Co-Manufacturing network.

In parallel, you will own the integrity of the numbers: forecasting, cost savings, master data, controls, and compliance. You will lead a small, talented finance team—developing team members and setting the standard for analytical quality and business partnering—while driving the digital and process transformation that makes the function faster, smarter, and more capable over time.

This role partners closely with Contract Manufacturing, Operations Finance, and Senior Leadership. It is built for a finance leader who can demonstrate financial rigor and governance with the influence to drive measurable business results.

JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

• Strategic Business Partnering & Co-Pilot to the Vice President of Contract Manufacturing — Act as the trusted financial advisor and Co-Pilot to the VP. Bring forward-looking insight, frame trade-offs, pressure-test assumptions, and influence strategy, investment, and cost decisions. Translate financial performance into a clear narrative for senior leadership and governance forums.

• Cost Savings & Value Creation — Own the delivery of validated, well-governed cost savings across sourcing, negotiation, and savings projects—ensuring reliable timing and clear financial visibility throughout the year. Partner with Procurement and Operations Finance to build and proactively manage a multi-year savings pipeline, and ensure savings are accurately reflected against the P&L in current and future years.

• Forecasting & Decision Support — Own forecasting for cost of production and related drivers across the Co-Manufacturing network. Establish a baseline for forecast accuracy, implement KPIs to track and improve it, and deliver scenario and risk/opportunity analysis that informs sound, timely decisions.

• Financial Delivery & Master Data — Ensure rigor and integrity across month-end close, scorecards, Bill of Materials (BOM), and master data. Provide analysis on obsolete materials—identifying trends and root causes behind raw and pack write-offs by division and co-manufacturer—and quantify the controllable opportunity.

• Internal Controls & Compliance — Strengthen the control environment and ensure ongoing compliance readiness. Maintain compliance-ready documentation across processes, controls, and risks; conduct periodic self-assessments to identify and close gaps; and address prior findings with sustainable corrective actions ahead of formal reviews. Foster a culture of transparency, governance, and continuous improvement.

• Digital Enablement & Transformation — Lead the digital transformation of Contract Manufacturing Finance—accelerating automation and analytics adoption to simplify work, unlock measurable capacity from manual processes, and improve the speed and quality of financial decision-making. Champion durable, scalable systems solutions (including within SAP) and convert capacity unlocked into higher-value analysis.

• Team Leadership & Talent Development — Lead, coach, and develop the Contract Manufacturing Finance team. Set clear, measurable objectives; provide regular, documented feedback; build robust development plans; and create a high-achieving, inclusive culture supported by clear action plans from employee listening and engagement programs.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

• BA/BS in Accounting or Finance, or a BA/BS degree with coursework up to and including intermediate accounting.

• Minimum of 8–12 years of progressive experience in Accounting or Finance, including operational or manufacturing finance.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

• CPA, CMA, CFM, CCE, or MBA.

• Food, CPG, or manufacturing industry experience.

• Strong command of US GAAP (or IAS) and cost accounting / activity-based costing principles; familiarity with Nestlé Accounting Standards (NAS) for internal candidates.

• Fluency in financial concepts including cash flow, NPV, IRR, return on investment, and Economic Profit, with the ability to model and communicate the drivers of product P&L.

• Proven ability to design financial and non-financial KPIs that drive improved business performance.

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; deep experience with SAP; proficiency with modern analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and a demonstrated bias toward automation.

• Experience leading process transformation and continuous-improvement initiatives at scale.

Proven ability to:

• Operate as a strategic partner to senior leadership—connecting financial analysis to operational and commercial outcomes.

• Own financial delivery end-to-end with rigor, accuracy, and strong governance.

• Deliver measurable cost savings and value creation through cross-functional partnership.

• Lead, build, focus, and motivate effective teams, and develop talent.

• Drive digital and process transformation that unlocks measurable capacity and improves decision quality.

• Influence senior stakeholders with clear, concrete, well-structured financial support.

• Network across functional and divisional silos and build consensus.

• Identify and quantify risks and opportunities and shape the response.

• Manage and prioritize competing demands to deliver the highest-impact results.

• Communicate effectively and persuasively in written and verbal form, including executive-level presentations.

jobs.title: Corporate Reporting Specialist (FP&A)
jobs.description:
経営層・グローバルへの財務レポーティングを通じて、企業経営の透明性と意思決定を支えるポジション

＊Business-level Japanese (speaking, writing & reading) is required for this position.
＊応募の際、次の書類をアップロードしてください（新規のかたはページ右下の応募するよりアカウントご作成いただけます）：
履歴書、職務履歴書、英文レジュメ

| ポジション概要

本ポジションは、Corporate Reporting Specialistとして、会社全体の業績や財務状況に関するレポーティング業務を担当します。
経営層やグローバル本社向けの財務報告資料の作成・管理を通じて、正確かつタイムリーな情報提供を実現し、経営判断を支える重要な役割を担います。
また、社内外のステークホルダーに対して一貫性のある財務情報を提供するため、各部門との連携を図りながらレポーティングプロセスの改善や標準化にも取り組んでいただきます

|部署紹介

当部署は、ネスレ日本のFP&A（Financial Planning & Analysis）機能として、事業部門（BU）および経営層の意思決定を、データと財務分析を通じて支援する経営企画機能です。
事業計画・業績予測の策定、業績分析、経営レポーティング、収益性向上に向けた財務インサイトの提供を通じて、持続的な事業成長に貢献しています。また、スイス本社や海外拠点と連携しながら、グローバル基準に基づくファイナンスプロセスの運営・改善を推進しています。
なお、本ポジションはFP&A組織内のCorporate Reportingチームに所属し、全社業績のレポーティングおよび財務データ管理を担当いただきます。

|業務内容

Corporate Reporting Specialistとして、以下の業務を担当いただきます。
• 月次・年次決算におけるスイス本社向け各種レポートの作成・提出（会社の公式業績数値の管理・報告）
