jobs.title: Senior Director of Sales Finance Co-Pilot
jobs.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

The Senior Director of Sales Finance Co-Pilot is the primary finance business partner to the President of Sales and Sales Leadership Team, and will report directly to the CFO, Holistic Health. The role leads Sales Finance across customer and channel performance, revenue growth management, trade investment, forecasting, commercial controls, and strategic revenue management support. The leader will support the Sales team through the carve-out from Nestlé and support the implementation of a new ISIT ERP platform while protecting business continuity and building scalable standalone Sales Finance capabilities.

Preference will be given to candidates located within the Northeast region of the US.

Scope of Responsibility

- Senior Finance leader responsible for Sales and Trade Finance, strategic revenue management, customer and channel profitability, revenue forecasting, and sales performance management.

- Leads and develops the Sales Finance organization

- Partners closely with Sales, Commercial Copilots, FP&A, Corporate Accounting

- Operates in a fast-paced transformation environment requiring analytical rigor, accounting discipline, commercial judgment, and strong change leadership.

Strategic Purpose

- Serve as the strategic finance co-pilot to the President of Sales, CFO, and Commercial Leadership Team, shaping customer and channel strategies that deliver profitable growth, cash generation, and value creation.

- Lead the Sales Finance organization through separation from Nestlé, organizational redesign, process transition, and the move to a standalone private equity-backed operating model.

- Lead Sales Finance activities for the implementation and stabilization of a new IS/IT ERP platform, ensuring continuity of trade management, customer reporting, forecasting, controls, and close processes.

- Apply strong accounting, financial planning, and analytical expertise to pricing, promotion, customer investment, channel, mix, portfolio, and resource allocation decisions.

- Build a high-performing Sales Finance team that delivers clear insights, constructive challenge, strong controls, and effective partnership through change.

Key Accountabilities

Sales Finance and Commercial Partnership

- Lead all Sales Finance activities, including customer planning, channel performance, sales forecasting support, trade investment, pricing support, customer profitability, and commercial performance reviews.

- Partner with Sales leadership to develop annual plans, customer strategies, joint business plans, and investment choices aligned with revenue, profit, market share, and cash objectives.

- Evaluate customer funding, promotions, pricing actions, terms, assortment changes, and other commercial proposals; provide clear recommendations based on return, strategic fit, cash impact, and risk.

- Provide timely visibility to financial performance, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions across customers, channels, brands, and commercial programs.

Revenue Growth Management and Trade Investment

- Provide financial leadership for RGM decisions across price, promotion, mix, trade architecture, pack-price strategy, and customer terms.

- Improve trade investment effectiveness through disciplined planning, approval, measurement, post-event evaluation, and reallocation of funds.

- Establish financial guardrails and decision frameworks that enable commercial teams to act quickly while maintaining accountability.

- Monitor market share, distribution, organic growth, trade rate, promotion effectiveness, and other commercial KPIs and recommend corrective action.

Accounting, Controls, and Forecasting

- Ensure accurate accounting and forecasting for trade spend customer programs, rebates, deductions, promotional accruals, gross-to-net sales, and related commercial activities.

- Maintain strong controls over customer funding, trade approvals, accruals, settlements, reconciliations, and commercial master data.

- Partner with Corporate Controllership on technical judgments, close, audit requirements, policies, and control remediation.

- Deliver accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual sales, trade, net sales, and customer profitability forecasts.

Carve-Out and Standalone Readiness

- Lead Sales Finance separation activities and readiness for close, and standalone operations

- Separate commercial processes, data, reports, policies, controls, and services with minimal disruption to customers or business performance.

- Identify Sales Finance capability gaps, transition risks, stranded costs, one-time requirements, and mitigation actions.

- Establish scalable standalone Sales Finance routines, reporting, governance, and performance management aligned with private equity ownership.

ERP and Sales Finance Transformation

- Serve as the senior Sales Finance lead for the new ERP platform, representing requirements across order-to-cash, pricing, deductions, trade promotion, accruals, forecasting, and customer profitability reporting.

- Oversee Sales Finance participation in process design, data mapping and cleansing, controls design, user acceptance testing, cutover, training, and post-go-live stabilization.

- Protect the accuracy and continuity of customer and trade data, commercial reporting, forecasts, accruals, deductions management, and period-end close.

- Champion standardized processes, automation, connected data, and self-service analytics that improve speed and decision quality.

People and Change Leadership

- Lead with clarity, resilience, empathy, and accountability through ownership, systems, process, and organizational change.

- Translate transformation priorities into executable plans while maintaining team engagement and delivery of critical commercial cycles.

- Assess capabilities, clarify roles and decision rights, recruit and retain critical talent, and build development and succession plans.

- Foster constructive challenge, cross-functional collaboration, disciplined problem-solving, and a culture of ownership.

Key Outputs / Deliverables

- Delivery of revenue, profit, trade investment, market share, working capital, and cash objectives with clear visibility to drivers and corrective actions.

- Accurate and timely customer, channel, trade, and net sales forecasts and management reporting.

- Improved pricing, promotion, trade investment, customer profitability, portfolio, and resource allocation decisions through actionable analysis.

- Successful transition of Sales Finance capabilities through carve-out, ERP deployment, and standalone stabilization.

- An effective commercial control environment with rigorous trade accounting, reconciliations, approvals, and risk management.

- A capable, engaged, and accountable Sales Finance team equipped to succeed in the standalone company.

Measures of Success

- Revenue, profit, trade efficiency, market share, working capital, and cash performance versus plan.

- Forecast accuracy, trade accrual accuracy, deduction resolution, close quality, and control effectiveness.

- Quality, speed, and adoption of customer and channel decision support.

Qualifications / Certifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or another analytical discipline required.

- MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced finance qualification preferred.

Critical Experience

Required

- 15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant Sales Finance or Commercial Finance leadership responsibility.

- Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Sales and Commercial leaders in consumer products, health and wellness, food, beverage, FMCG

- Deep experience in customer finance, trade investment, RGM, pricing, customer profitability, sales forecasting, and commercial performance management.

- Strong accounting expertise in trade spend, accruals, rebates, deductions, gross-to-net sales, financial reporting, and internal controls.

- Advanced analytical and financial modeling capability with a record of converting data into practical commercial recommendations and measurable outcomes.

- Proven success leading teams through organizational, systems, ownership, or business change.

Preferred

- Experience supporting carve-outs, divestitures, integrations, or transition service arrangements.

- Experience in performance environment focused on rapid value creation and cash delivery.

- Experience establishing standalone Sales Finance processes, controls, systems, reporting, and organization capabilities.

- Experience leading or playing a major finance role in ERP implementation, including process design, data, testing, cutover, training, and stabilization.

Leadership Capabilities

- Commercial acumen and strategic business partnership

- Sales Finance, RGM, and trade investment expertise

- Analytical decision support and financial storytelling

- Accounting rigor and control ownership

- Business transformation leadership

- Leading teams through change

- Talent development and cross-functional collaboration

- Executive influence and constructive challenge

Working Conditions

This role operates in a fast-paced transformation environment. Periodic travel and flexibility during transaction, ERP cutover, planning, close, and other critical commercial milestones may be required.

Location: North York, ON located at 25 Sheppard Ave W, North York, ON M2N 6S8;

A little bit about us

While Nestlé is known for KitKat®, Gerber®, Nescafe®, and Maggi®, our recipe for success comes down to one thing: our people.

We strive to lead a people-focused culture that empowers employees to bring their authentic selves to work each day. What to Expect:

As Senior Director, Human Resources, you will be the senior-most people leader for the standalone Ice Cream business in Canada and a member of the business leadership team. Partnering directly with the President of Ice Cream, you will set and lead the end-to-end people agenda across talent, organization design, employee and labour relations, total rewards, payroll, HR governance and change leadership. This position is a brand-new role.

A day in the life:

As Senior Director, Human Resources, you will partner closely with the President of Ice Cream and the Ice Cream Leadership Team to build organizational capability, establish standalone people practices and ensure the HR function supports the business effectively. This highly visible role requires both strategic direction-setting and hands-on execution, including building processes, solving issues, coaching leaders and supporting employees through change.

You will also:

- Serve as the senior people advisor to the President of Ice Cream and the Ice Cream Leadership Team on business strategy, organization effectiveness, culture, leadership and employee matters.

- Develop and execute the Canadian People Strategy, aligning talent, culture, organization, labour and HR priorities with business objectives and growth ambitions.

- Lead organizational design, workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning and leadership development.

- Lead the labour relations strategy across unionized manufacturing operations, including collective bargaining, grievance management and arbitration support.

- Build constructive relationships with union leadership and other key employee relations stakeholders.

- Lead transformation, restructuring, integration and change management initiatives, translating strategy into practical action.

- Oversee total rewards, recognition, wellness, payroll, HR governance and core people processes, with a focus on reliable standalone practices and continuity during transition.

- Use people data and insights to guide decisions, identify risks and improve organizational performance.

- Build a high-performing, inclusive culture that strengthens the employee experience.

- Manage the HR budget, external providers, payroll partners and internal HR team members, including the HR Manager supporting the London factory.

Role Requirements

- A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations or a related field; a master's degree is an asset.

- A CHRL or CHRE designation is preferred.

- 12+ years of progressive Human Resources leadership experience.

- Significant experience partnering with senior executives and leadership teams.

- Proven experience supporting unionized manufacturing or industrial operations.

- Demonstrated success leading collective bargaining and complex employee relations matters.

- Experience leading organizational transformation, mergers, acquisitions, integrations or large-scale change.

- Experience working in a lean, fast-paced organization where strategic leadership, hands-on execution and comfort with ambiguity are equally important.

- Multi-site Canadian experience is strongly preferred.

- Strong executive presence, commercial acumen, emotional intelligence and the ability to influence at all levels.

Benefits

- Comprehensive total rewards benefits package including Health and Dental benefits that start on day one of employment

- Company matched pension plan

- Four weeks of Vacation and five personal days (Personal Paid Holidays)

- Flexible and hybrid work arrangements

- Excellent training and development programs as well as opportunities to grow within the company

- Access to Educational Assistance & Tuition Reimbursement

- Bonus eligibility

- Gender affirmation benefits to ensure access to necessary care, resources, and coverage for gender-affirming procedures

- Fertility Services and Surrogacy Medical Coverage to support the pursuit of a path to parenthood regardless of medical conditions, gender or sexual orientation

- Adoption benefits to remove some of the financial barriers associated with adoption

- Access to the Discount Company store with Nestlé, Nespresso, and Purina products (Located across various Nestle offices/sites)

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager Nespresso Nordic
jobs.description:
Join Nespresso Nordics

Are you passionate about driving growth through data, digital media, and customer acquisition? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where performance marketing, eCommerce, analytics, and business impact go hand in hand?

We are now looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to join Nespresso Nordics and take ownership of our digital acquisition agenda across the Nordic markets.

Working at Nespresso

At Nespresso, coffee is at the center of everything we do, but people are at the heart of our success. We believe coffee can be a force for good, creating positive impact for our customers, our communities, and our planet.

As part of our Nordic team, you will work in a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement drive our business forward. You will be based in Stockholm.

Your Role

As Performance Marketing Manager, you will be part of the Digital Marketing Team under Nordic Brand & Communications and work closely with E-Commerce, Commercial, Trade, Finance, B2B and stakeholders across the Nordic markets and Nespresso HQ.

Your mission is to drive profitable growth by increasing visibility, demand, traffic, and customer acquisition across Nespresso's digital ecosystem.

You will own the relationship with our performance agencies and ensure that campaigns are strategically planned, executed, optimized, and clearly linked to business outcomes. While agency partners handle much of the operational execution, you should have sufficient hands-on experience to challenge recommendations and identify opportunities across platforms and channels.

You are responsible for performance reporting and a key part of the role is helping the organization understand not only what happened, but why it happened and what should happen next.

Key Responsibilities

Performance Plan & Growth

- Improve and execute the Nordic acquisition plan across key digital performance channels.

- Drive quality traffic, customer acquisition, retention and sales growth.

- Translate business objectives into actionable channel strategies and investment priorities.

- Identify growth opportunities through market trends, customer behaviour and competitive analysis.

Search & Performance Marketing

- Lead and challenge strategies across Paid Search, SEO, Affiliate Marketing, always-on Paid Social, and emerging performance channels.

- Drive continuous optimization across campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.

- Support One Search thinking by connecting paid and organic opportunities into one performance view.

Agency Leadership

- Lead our performance agencies day-to-day. Build strong partnerships while maintaining accountability and performance expectations.

- Ensure campaigns are planned, launched, optimized, budgeted, phased, and reported to the highest standards.

- Challenge recommendations constructively and ensure a strong focus on execution quality, commercial impact, and innovation.

Analytics, Reporting & Insights

- Own reporting and performance analysis end-to-end.

- Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks using GA4, Data Studio, SA360, and other relevant tools.

- Combine media, commercial, and customer data to uncover business-driving insights.

- Translate complex findings into clear recommendations for both specialist and senior stakeholders.

- Establish KPI frameworks that connect channel performance to business outcomes.

Budget & Investment Management

- Budget planning, phasing, tracking, and performance follow-up.

- Recommend reallocations and optimization opportunities based on performance results.

- Contribute to forecasting, scenario planning, and growth modelling.

We Are Looking For

- You are commercially minded, data-driven, and passionate about turning insights into action. You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders and are comfortable challenging agencies and partners to achieve the best possible results.

In addition, you:

- Have 5+ years of experience working within Performance Marketing or Digital Acquisition.

- Have hands-on experience managing channels such as Search (SEM). A plus if you’ve worked hands on with Paid Social, Digital Media and Affiliate Marketing.

- Have strong analytical capabilities and experience building dashboards, conducting performance analysis, and translating data into clear business recommendations

- Have experience with platforms such as GA4, SA360, Data Studio, Campaign Manager, and major advertising platforms.

- Have experience working with media agencies and external partners.

- Communicate confidently in English. Knowledge of a Scandinavian language is an advantage but not required.

Why Join Nespresso?

At Nespresso, you'll have the opportunity to work with one of the world's strongest premium brands while influencing digital growth across the Nordic markets. You'll be part of a highly collaborative team where your expertise, ideas, and ambition will help shape the future of our digital consumer experience.

The Selection Process & Contact

We will interview suitable candidates as they apply, so please do not hesitate to take this opportunity to submit your application and CV as soon as possible, and by October 25, 2026, at the latest. If you have any questions regarding the job, please contact Nordic Digital Marketing Manager for Nespresso, Daniela Bonardi on LinkedIn. Please note that we only accept applications that are sent to us via our Careers site.

jobs.title: Customer Strategy Manager (Vital Proteins)
jobs.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Customer Strategy Manager is responsible for driving achievement of forecast, budget within a specific division while instituting strategic business plans that integrate, align and achieve business goals. The incumbent will lead the commercialization business planning process by influencing go-to-market strategies that drive profitable growth, product launches, and coordinate the efforts of commercialization planning to drive business success for Vital Proteins. The incumbent serves as a liaison between sales and marketing as well as other cross functional partners by providing voice of customer. This person also needs to be effective in influencing marketing and brand strategies all while being a source of retailer and competitive insights for their internal partners. Special projects are an integral part of this role and the ideal person should be comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast past environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Leads business planning process by developing analytics & insights to support marketing strategy, preparing timelines & communication of the process, and conducting collaborative planning cycles with customer teams.

- Communicates & coordinates key strategies, insights, and initiatives between field and internal teams as well as gains alignment across all major functions.

As Manager, Human Resources, you will serve as the dedicated HR partner for the Waters and Premium Beverages team in Canada. Reporting to the Head of Human Resources, Americas Cluster, with dotted-line accountability to the Canada BEO, you will be a member of the Canada Waters Leadership Team and help translate business priorities into practical people strategies and actions. Supporting a business of approximately $300M in Sales and over 50 employees, you will partner closely with leaders to strengthen organizational capability, talent, culture and engagement. You will play a critical role in leading transformation initiatives and enabling effective change management to support the business’s future growth and organizational objectives. This is an individual contributor role and requires a commercially minded, hands-on HR leader who can balance strategic partnership with strong day-to-day execution.

A day in the life of the Manager, Human Resources:

As the HR Business Partner for Waters and Premium Beverages, you will work closely with the Canada Waters Leadership Team to advance business and people priorities. You will provide thoughtful counsel, use data and insights to inform decisions, and ensure core people processes are delivered consistently and effectively across the team.

- Serve as a trusted people advisor to the Canada BEO and Canada Waters Leadership Team on business strategy, organization effectiveness, culture, leadership, talent, and employee matters.

You are a commercially minded HR professional who combines strong business partnership with practical execution. - Excellent coaching, communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively at all levels.

Nestlé Professional Solutions, the Out of Home Division at Nestlé USA, is looking for a Brand Marketing Associate with experience in product management and a track record of success growing business and improving returns via product portfolio management. This role will support the development of strategic recommendations based on robust analysis.  The Marketing Associate will have responsibility for profitably growing the Sauce Category and developing business and marketing objectives, strategy and tactics for the business, and executing against these plans. jobs.description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

Job Summary

As a member of the Accounting Operations function, the Senior Finance Analyst (Intragroup Accounting Operations) is responsible for overseeing onshore and offshore intragroup accounting activities and ensuring accurate and timely recording, reconciliation, settlement, elimination, and reporting of related-party transactions. The scope includes intercompany receivables and payables, loans, royalties, interest income and expense, and other intragroup activities.

The role requires a strong understanding of accounting and business operations, exceptional analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to solve complex business and accounting challenges. The Senior Analyst collaborates with operating companies and cross-functional teams, including Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Corporate Accounting, Consolidation, Technology, and Shared Services, to streamline processes and maintain strong working relationships across entities.

This position works with all operating companies in the U.S. market and supports their intragroup accounting transformation and change management initiatives. The Senior Analyst also serves as a subject matter expert for strategic programs, including Legal Entity Rationalization (LER), mergers, divestitures, entity integrations and dissolutions, SAP deconsolidation, system implementations, and other organizational transformation projects.

Responsibilities

- Serve as the subject matter expert for intragroup accounting activities across assigned legal entities and operating companies, ensuring compliance with Nestlé Accounting Standards and company policies.

- Ensure accurate and timely accounting, reconciliation, settlement, elimination, and reporting of intragroup transactions while maintaining financial integrity and transparency.

- Lead the resolution of aged intragroup balances, reconciliation exceptions, and recurring accounting issues through root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions.

- Review and analyze end-to-end accounting and business processes to identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, automation, digital enablement, and enhanced controls.

- Lead and support process transformation and change management initiatives, ensuring successful implementation and adoption of new processes, systems, tools, and ways of working.

- Act as the Intragroup Accounting lead or key contributor for Legal Entity Rationalization initiatives, including mergers, dissolutions, integrations, restructurings, acquisitions, and divestitures.

- Assess and coordinate the accounting impacts of strategic projects, including legal entity changes, ERP implementations, SAP deconsolidations, and business transformation programs.

- Partner with Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Corporate Accounting, Consolidation, Technology, Shared Services, and business stakeholders to deliver effective accounting and operational solutions.

- Develop and maintain governance frameworks, internal controls, standard operating procedures, and documentation that support compliance, audit readiness, and operational excellence.

- Develop and communicate meaningful analytics, dashboards, key performance indicators, and management reporting to provide insight into operational performance, project progress, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.

- Advanced Excel experience with data visualization or automation tools required.

- Minimum of four years of progressive experience in accounting, financial analysis, or related finance operations, preferably in a shared service center or multinational organization.

- Experience with SAP or a similar ERP system and Microsoft applications; advanced Excel and experience with data visualization or automation tools preferred.

- Strong understanding of accounting principles, intragroup accounting, reconciliations, eliminations, and related-party reporting requirements.

- Experience leading or supporting process improvement, transformation, automation, and change management initiatives.

- Experience collaborating with offshore or global shared service teams and influencing stakeholders across functions and entities preferred.

Skills

- Analytical thinking and problem solving; uses data, accounting knowledge, and root-cause analysis to address complex problems.

- Attention to detail; reviews information carefully to ensure accuracy, completeness, and financial integrity.

- Communication and business partnership; explains financial concepts clearly and adapts communication to the audience.

- Collaboration and stakeholder influence; builds trusted relationships and helps drive outcomes across functions, entities, and service teams.

- Accountability and initiative; follows through on commitments, takes appropriate ownership, and operates effectively with limited supervision.

- Results focus and prioritization; manages multiple priorities and supports delivery of high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

- Digital and continuous improvement mindset; identifies opportunities for automation, visualization, standardization, and simplification.

jobs.title: Fruits Sourcing Associate - Swat (Contractual)
jobs.description:
Location: Mingora, Swat
Employment Type: Contractual
Job Type: Full-time, Field

Position Summary
To support sustainable fruit sourcing and procurement by developing strong partnerships with fruit farmers, promoting Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), and driving orchard development initiatives. The role is responsible for ensuring reliable fruit supply, providing market intelligence, advancing sustainability programs, and maintaining compliance with food safety, quality, and company standards to support business objectives.

A Day in the Life…

- Advise and support fruit orchard farmers on Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) to improve fruit quality, productivity, and sustainability.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with fruit farmers, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure a reliable and sustainable fruit supply base.

- Identify and develop new orchards to support localization and long-term fruit procurement strategies.

- Monitor fruit market dynamics, crop conditions, fruit availability, and pricing trends to provide accurate market intelligence for sourcing decisions.

- Conduct sustainability assessments and maintain accurate records through approved systems and tools.

- Support the development and implementation of emission reduction plans for selected project farms.

- Promote and implement water conservation initiatives, including drip irrigation and sensor-based technologies, across designated farming areas.

- Ensure compliance with food safety, quality, sustainability, regulatory, WHO Code, and Local Code requirements in all sourcing activities.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support sourcing plans and achieve procurement targets.

- Maintain accurate documentation and reporting related to farmer engagement, orchard development, sustainability initiatives, and procurement activities.

- Engage farmers and suppliers proactively to understand their needs and provide timely solutions that support long-term partnerships.

What Will Make You Successful

- University or technical degree in Agronomy, Food Sciences, Agriculture, or an equivalent discipline.

- Hands-on exposure to working with farmers, agricultural projects, or rural communities.

- Experience in fruit procurement, sourcing operations, or agricultural supply chains.

- Good understanding of farming practices, farmer engagement, and rural market dynamics.

- Knowledge of Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), food safety, quality standards, and sustainable agriculture practices.

- Understanding of sustainability initiatives, including farm assessments, emission reduction programs, and water conservation projects.

- Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret market intelligence related to fruit availability and pricing.

- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and persuasion skills to effectively engage farmers, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

- Demonstrated teamwork and collaboration capabilities.

- Personal integrity and courage to uphold company standards, business principles, and compliance requirements.

- Proven ability to work independently and ensure compliance across all areas of responsibility.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and reporting tools.

- Farmer-centric mindset with a strong focus on delivering timely and practical solutions.

- Passion for sustainable agriculture and rural community development.

jobs.title: Customer Facing Supply Chain Specialist (B2B Planning)
jobs.description:
At Nespresso, we place people and specialty coffee at the heart of what we do. As part of our team, you'll be empowered to inspire, care, act, and innovate to reach your full potential and reimagine what coffee can be. As a certified B Corporation, we're committed to driving our triple bottom line – People, Profit, and Planet – by delivering an exceptional coffee experience that elevates our community, suppliers, farmers, and each other, channeling our growth-minded spirit to set new standards in global coffee culture. Quality, sustainability, diversity, and inclusion are core to who we are and critical to our vision of driving positive change. Throughout our factories, boutiques, and office locations, Nespresso careers are brimming with best-in-class opportunities for your development and growth. Join us!

Job Summary:

The Customer Facing Supply Chain Specialist (B2B) ensures flawless execution of the order-to-cash process, compliance with contractual standards and delivery of high service levels to Trade and B2B customers. These B2B customers include Hotels, Restaurants, Cafes, Cruise Ships and other large B2B businesses. This role focuses on operational excellence, chargeback prevention and cost-to-serve optimization, while leveraging AI and automation tools to improve productivity and accuracy. The Customer Facing Supply Chain Specialist will also support continuous improvement initiatives and collaborates with internal teams and external partners to sustain efficiency and customer satisfaction. This is a hybrid-based role located in Manhattan, NY (Herald Square) – working 2 days/week onsite and 3 days/week remote.

Responsibilities:

Execute and Monitor Order-to-Cash Process

•    Process customer orders accurately and on time, ensuring compliance with agreed standards and Terms & Conditions.
•    Validate order details and pricing using AI-powered anomaly detection tools.
•    Track OTIF performance daily and escalate risks proactively.
•    Use AI Agents to automate repetitive tasks such as order confirmations and delivery status updates.
•    Serve as the single point of contact for order-related inquiries, ensuring timely communication and resolution of issues across internal teams and external partners.

Support Cost-to-Serve Optimization and Chargeback Management

•    Validate and manage chargebacks, ensuring accurate documentation and timely dispute resolution.
•    Analyze cost drivers and propose improvements to reduce cost-to-serve.
•    Apply AI-driven analytics to detect patterns in chargebacks and predict risk areas.
•    Collaborate with finance and logistics teams to implement corrective actions.
•    Act as the single point of contact for cost-to-serve and chargeback inquiries, ensuring clear communication and alignment between customers and internal stakeholders.

Ensure Compliance and Contractual Standards

•    Maintain adherence to Supply Chain standards defined in contracts with retailers and partners.
•    Document all processes and decisions to ensure audit readiness.
•    Use AI-based compliance monitoring tools to flag deviations proactively.
•    Support periodic reviews of Terms & Conditions and update operational workflows accordingly.

Deliver Data-Driven Insights and Reporting

•    Prepare and update dashboards on OTIF, cost-to-serve, and chargeback performance.
•    Use SQL, Python, and AI tools to automate reporting and generate predictive insights.
•    Implement AI Agents for real-time monitoring and automated alerts on service risks.
•    Provide actionable recommendations to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.

Support Continuous Improvement and Collaboration

•    Participate in NCE-driven initiatives to improve processes and reduce manual workload.
•    Collaborate with DSP, Logistics, Transportation, and Commercial teams to ensure seamless execution.
•    Use AI Agents to streamline communication and task management across teams.
•    Contribute ideas for automation and digital transformation projects.

Requirements:

•    Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or in a related field required.
•    2-3+ years of professional work experience in Customer Supply Chain, Logistics or Order Management is required.
•    Familiarity with coding languages such as Python is highly preferred.
•    Knowledge of order-to-cash processes, chargeback handling and compliance standards is required.
•    Demonstrated fluency in MS Office (Word/Excel/Outlook/PowerPoint) is required.
•    Must have excellent communication (oral and written), presentation, organizational and stakeholder management skills (including the ability to develop and maintain strong, cross-functional stakeholder relationships) is required.
•    Willing and able to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines with minimal supervision.
•    Experience with ERP systems such as SAP is a plus.
•    Willing and able to travel up to 10% based on the needs of the team and the business required.

The approximate pay range for this position is $95,000 to $105,000. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as geographic location.

jobs.description:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

The Quality Specialist - Compliance Analyst will assure that products meet the company’s high standards, expectations, and compliance to quality and food safety regulations. Promote full compliance to both internal and external Nestlé requirements within the scope of Nestlé Continuous Excellence (NCE) Foundations at the site. This position will be working with the Factory Compliance Network and SME’s, establish, maintain, and improve the factory’s Compliance Routines. This position will also lead the Compliance Network within the Factory, maintaining a focus on developing competency in compliance systems, tools and methodologies.

System Accountability

- Audit Management (Internal, External)

- Management Review

- Document Control

- Record Control

Training, Coaching, & Assessing

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

- B.S. Degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or other related field, preferred.

Experience

- Internal Auditor Certification to ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 or FSSC/ISO 22000.

- Process-Based Auditing systems such as ISO.

- Compliance management experience (Quality, SH&E, HR, Finance, or other).

- NCE Goal Alignment experience: factory or head office.

- Leading continuous improvement projects.

Required Skills

- Interpersonal Influence – ability to influence others within the organization to be excited, enthused and committed to furthering the objectives.

- Accountability – accept personal responsibility for the quality and timeliness of work. Can be relied upon to achieve results with minimal oversight.

- Good business insight and understanding – knowledge and understanding of the organization and business and functional relationships.

jobs.description:
POSITION SNAPSHOT

Location: Meycauayan, Bulacan
Nestlé Business Solutions
Full time, Hybrid
Bachelor’s Degree
1+ year of experience

POSITION SUMMARY

Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and beverage company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

Our Team in Nestlé Business Solutions is in charge of delivering world class business support to our colleagues and clients in Nestlé globally. We are committed to deliver with passion, reliability, innovation, discipline and excellence. Are you ready to join us?

A day in the life of...

Ensure cloud solutions used for business purposes in the market are identified, investigated, registered, assessed, and governed in accordance with the Cloud Compliance Process. Maintain reliable compliance records, coordinate timely assessments and remediation, and monitor Security Compliance Index (SCI) alerts for public cloud infrastructure. Provide clear status, risk, and escalation information to accountable Market IT, Market FRM, and governance stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.

-
Cloud Discovery and Investigation

• Produce the agreed market cloud usage report and triage newly identified solutions

• Place applicable solutions Under Investigation and complete documented business-versus-personal-use investigations

• Recommend use of an approved global solution or escalation to the Market FRM for registration and assessment

• Maintain a complete and current Application Investigation and Exclusion Register with evidence, outcome, owner, status, and next action

-
Cloud Assessment and Record Governance

• Create and maintain complete cloud solution records in Archer

• Coordinate required Business Impact Assessments, Privacy Impact Assessments, Cloud Compliance assessments, and reassessments with Business Owners, providers, and SMEs

• Track due dates, evidence, control requirements, decisions, and lifecycle status; escalate overdue or blocked items to the accountable owner

• Provide accurate compliance status and risk reporting for the assigned market portfolio

-
Remediation and SCI Monitoring

• Define and track remediation plans with IT Application Owners and Business Owners for missing or non-compliant controls

• Monitor SCI alerts for public cloud infrastructure, assign actions, coordinate vendor remediation, and provide status to accountable Market IT

• Escalate overdue critical/high-risk findings, missed commitments, and unresolved control gaps through the agreed governance path

• Maintain effective working relationships across Market IT, Market FRM, governance teams, SMEs, Business Owners, and service providers

What will make you successful

- Can join the team ASAP

- Graduate of bachelor’s degree in Information Technology

- Minimum of 6 months experience in IT

- Relevant experience in cloud governance, information security, technology risk, compliance operations, audit, or a related field

- Practical experience producing operational reports, investigating exceptions, maintaining evidence, and tracking actions through closure

- Working knowledge of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS service models and public, private, hybrid, and community deployment models

- Ability to interpret standards and control requirements, assess risk, identify evidence gaps, and make clear recommendations

- Strong analytical, investigation, problem-solving, prioritization, and written documentation skills

- Confident English communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including providers and senior stakeholders

- Experience working across global, virtual, and cross-functional teams and coordinating across regions and time zones

- Relevant cloud, security, risk, audit, or privacy certification is advantageous but not mandatory, subject to the approved role standard

jobs.title: S2P Procurement Analyst
jobs.description:
Nestlé Business Solutions LATAM | Asunción, Paraguay.

S2P /  Source to Pay  Centralized Requestor /  Analista de Solicitudes de Compras

Turno Disponible: Lunes a Viernes de 09:00 a 19:00

Nestlé Business Services está en la búsqueda de personas extraordinarias para unirse a nuestro equipo de clase mundial.

En Paraguay, contamos con dos unidades de Nestlé:

Nestlé Paraguay, responsable de la importación y distribución de nuestras marcas líderes, ha estado presente en el mercado hace 25 años.

Por otro lado, somos Nestlé Business Solutions Asunción, el centro de servicios de Nestlé. Desde 2018, hemos estado operando en el mercado, ofreciendo servicios de en áreas como Supply Chain, Finanzas, Recursos Humanos, y Marketing Digital y Redes Sociales a todas las operaciones de Nestlé en América Latina, desde México hasta el sur del continente. Nuestros clientes son nuestros colegas.

Nos enorgullece ser un equipo multicultural y diverso de profesionales apasionados por impulsar la mejora continua de procesos en colaboración con colegas de todo el mundo. Nos comprometemos a proporcionar servicios de alta calidad que apoyen la agilidad empresarial y fomenten la innovación digital.

Si te identificas con esta descripción y estás buscando una oportunidad para unirte a una empresa donde realmente puedas aportar valor, ¡te invitamos a considerar unirte a Nestlé Business Services!

Resumen de posición

Nestlé Business Solutions es un lugar dinámico y desafiante para trabajar. Como Source to Pay Centralized Requestor Analyst  serás responsable de brindar soporte a los Departamentos de Compras de las distintas subsidiarias de Nestlé en LATAM, con el objetivo de atender las necesidades relacionadas con los procesos de generación de solicitudes de Órdenes de Compra, seguimiento de la facturación de proveedores y otros procesos derivados de las responsabilidades de los Departamentos de Compras locales.

También se espera que seas responsable de la consolidación y análisis diario de las operaciones transaccionales, resolviendo problemas de manera proactiva e identificando oportunidades de mejora continua.

Además, serás responsable de brindar soporte a los diferentes usuarios de las unidades de negocio de las subsidiarias de Nestlé, gestionando facturas pendientes de proveedores que no han realizado su facturación en tiempo y forma. Deberás dar seguimiento a las partes interesadas y coordinar con el equipo de Solicitantes Centralizados (Centralized Requestor Team) para contribuir al cumplimiento de los objetivos anuales establecidos por la compañía.

Un día en la vida de…

Soporte técnico al equipo y a los mercados de Nestlé. Será el punto de contacto local para mercados específicos de América Latina en la resolución de incidencias relacionadas con facturas, participando en reuniones semanales y mensuales con los principales stakeholders. Asimismo, trabajará en iniciativas de mejora continua para optimizar los procesos y colaborará con el equipo para alcanzar los objetivos regionales establecidos.

¿Qué te hará exitoso?

Estudiantes universitarios de carreras como administración de empresas economía, o afines.

Excel intermedio/avanzado (Excluyente).

Inglés intermedio ( Deseable).

Conocimientos del proceso de compra  (Procurement).

Conocimiento del proceso S2P(Conocimiento del proceso de abastecimiento y pagos solicitudes de compra, órdenes de compra, recepción de materiales y gestión de facturas)

especialmente en gestión de facturas pendientes (Parked) y bloqueadas por discrepancias (Blocked).

Realizar benchmarking para identificar oportunidades de ventaja competitiva.

Gestionar reportes en Excel a nivel intermedio; nivel avanzado será considerado un diferencial.

Capacidad para consolidar datos, preparar resultados y presentar análisis.

Conocimiento de SAP (deseable).

Conocimiento de metodologías de Mejora Continua (deseable).
